accountNumber.description: Asendia's account number designated for the shipper. This will be provided at account setup.

subAccountNumber.description: Asendia's sub account number designated for the shipper, if applicable. This will be provided at account setup.

shippingLocation.description:
The location customer is shipping from: either customer drops off parcels from this shipping location to Asendia processing location or Asendia picks up parcels at this designated shipping location
For each customer each location has a unique code and one of them is set as default location.
For the default location, DEFAULT value can be used instead of location code which makes setup easier for customers with a unique location.
If customer has several locations, field must be populated with the code of the location provided during onboarding phase.

pickupCarrier.description:
The Asendia's location in where the physical package will be processed.
Equivalent of "Pickup Carrier" field from Job creation but using codes rather than free text.
- if customer drops himself shipments to processsing location, then pickupCarrier=CUSTDROPOFF (*)
- if a pickup is requested, then pickupCarrier=ASPICKUP (*)
- if Direct Access, then pickupCarrier=DIRECTA
- if other carrier is concerned, use related code

trackingIdentifier.description: Can be used in case of customer drop-off if a carrier is used for transport and provides a tracking number/identifier. Customer and Asendia can accordinglyu track shipment from customer location to Asendia processing location

transportReference.description: Used for Direct Access to capture transport or shipping reference such as MAWB number

customerReferenceNumber1.description: Users have the option of entering notes for their own purposes in these three fields.  Any notes entered will display on the shipping control document (SCD), reports, and invoices.

shipmentsToClose.description:
See shipmentsToClose object
Array - list of parcels or orders or receptacles/containers or dispatches to be closed
Must contain at least one number
Each shipment can be identified using one of the following number types:
- trackingNumber of a Parcel (retrieved from Create Parcel) if you want to close parcels one by one
- or orderNumber (provided by customer in Create Parcel) if you want to close parcels using their order numbers - if several parcels have the same order number, they will all be closed except if a parcel was closed before
- or containerNumber (provided by Create Container) if you want to close all parcels within a bag
- or dispatchNumber (provided by customer in Create Parcel) if you want to close all parcels nested in the same customer dispatch
Important: don't mix number types in the same request so don't provid a mix of tracking numbers and order numbers. Provide only tracking numbers or only order numbers or only dispatch numbers or only container numbers

trackingNumber.description: trackingNumber of a Parcel (retrieved from Create Parcel)

orderNumber.description:
orderNumber (provided by customer in Create Parcel)
If several parcels have the same order number, they will all be closed except if a parcel was closed before

containerNumber.description:
containerNumber (provided by Create Container)
You must provide at least one number and number types cannot be mixed: only trackingNumbers, or only orderNumbers, or only dispatchNumbers, or only containerNumbers

dispatchNumber.description:
dispatchNumber (provided by customer in Create Parcel)
You must provide at least one number and number types cannot be mixed: only trackingNumbers, or only orderNumbers, or only dispatchNumbers, or only containerNumbers
